lines.gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਮਨਿ ਆਸ ਘਨੇਰੀ ਕੋਈ ਐਸਾ ਸੰਤੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਪਿਰਹਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: darasan kee man aas ghaneree koee aisaa sa(n)t mo kau pirahi milaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: My mind's desire for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan is so great. Is there any Saint who can lead me to meet my Beloved? ||1||Pause||
The four watches of the day are like the four ages.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੈਣਿ ਭਈ ਤਬ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਨੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: rain bhaee tab a(n)t na jaane ||2||
lines.translation: And when night comes, I think that it shall never end. ||2||
The five demons have joined together, to separate me from my Husband Lord.
Wandering and rambling, I cry out and wring my hands. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak kau har daras dikhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: The Lord has revealed the Blessed Vision of His Darshan to servant Nanak;
realizing his own self, he has obtained supreme peace. ||4||15||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
In the Lord's service, are the greatest treasures.
Serving the Lord, the Ambrosial Naam comes into one's mouth. ||1||
The Lord is my Companion; He is with me, as my Help and Support.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਖਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਿਮਰੀ ਤਹ ਮਉਜੂਦੁ ਜਮੁ ਬਪੁਰਾ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕਹਾ ਡਰਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: dukh sukh simaree tah maujood jam bapuraa mo kau kahaa daraaee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: In pain and pleasure, whenever I remember Him, He is present. How can the poor Messenger of Death frighten me now? ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਓਟ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਤਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: har meree ot mai har kaa taan ||
lines.translation: The Lord is my Support; the Lord is my Power.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਖਾ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: har meraa sakhaa man maahi deebaan ||2||
lines.translation: The Lord is my Friend; He is my mind's advisor. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਵੇਸਾਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: har meree poo(n)jee meraa har vesaahu ||
lines.translation: The Lord is my capital; the Lord is my credit.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਧਨੁ ਖਟੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਾਹੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh dhan khatee har meraa saahu ||3||
lines.translation: As Gurmukh, I earn the wealth, with the Lord as my Banker. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਇਹ ਮਤਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kirapaa te ih mat aavai ||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, this wisdom has come.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੪॥੧੬॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak har kai a(n)k samaavai ||4||16||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak has merged into the Being of the Lord. ||4||16||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਤ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabh hoi kripaal ta ihu man laaee ||
lines.translation: When God shows His Mercy, then this mind is focused on Him.
Serving the True Guru, all rewards are obtained. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਿਉ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਕਰਹਿਗਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: man kiu bairaag karahigaa satigur meraa pooraa ||
lines.translation: O my mind, why are you so sad? My True Guru is Perfect.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਸਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਭ ਸੁਖ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰਿ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਭਰਪੂਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: manasaa kaa daataa sabh sukh nidhaan a(n)mrit sar sad hee bharapooraa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: He is the Giver of blessings, the treasure of all comforts; His Ambrosial Pool of Nectar is always overflowing. ||1||Pause||
One who enshrines His Lotus Feet within the heart,
meets the Beloved Lord; the Divine Light is revealed to him. ||2||
The five companions have met together to sing the songs of joy.
The unstruck melody, the sound current of the Naad, vibrates and resounds. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤੁਠਾ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur naanak tuthaa miliaa har raai ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, when the Guru is totally pleased, one meets the Lord, the King.
Then, the night of one's life passes in peace and natural ease. ||4||17||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
Showing His Mercy, the Lord has revealed Himself to me.
Meeting the True Guru, I have received the perfect wealth. ||1||
Gather such a wealth of the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਾਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਲੈ ਜਲਿ ਨਹੀ ਡੂਬੈ ਸੰਗੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਤਹੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhaahi na jaalai jal nahee doobai sa(n)g chhod kar katahu na jaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: It cannot be burned by fire, and water cannot drown it; it does not forsake society, or go anywhere else. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨਿਖੁਟਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tot na aavai nikhut na jaai ||
lines.translation: It does not run short, and it does not run out.
Eating and consuming it, the mind remains satisfied. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਘਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਾਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: so sach saahu jis ghar har dhan sa(n)chaanaa ||
lines.translation: He is the true banker, who gathers the wealth of the Lord within his own home.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਧਨ ਤੇ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਵਰਸਾਣਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: is dhan te sabh jag varasaanaa ||3||
lines.translation: With this wealth, the whole world profits. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਿਸੁ ਪੁਰਬ ਲਿਖੇ ਕਾ ਲਹਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: tin har dhan paaiaa jis purab likhe kaa lahanaa ||
lines.translation: He alone receives the Lord's wealth, who is pre-ordained to receive it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਤਿ ਵਾਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਗਹਣਾ ॥੪॥੧੮॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak a(n)t vaar naam gahanaa ||4||18||
lines.translation: O servant Nanak, at that very last moment, the Naam shall be your only decoration. ||4||18||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
Just like the farmer, He plants His crop,
and, whether it is ripe or unripe, He cuts it down. ||1||
Just so, you must know this well, that whoever is born, shall die.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਭਗਤੁ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਹੈ ਥੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: govi(n)d bhagat asathir hai theeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Only the devotee of the Lord of the Universe becomes stable and permanent. ||1||Pause||
The day shall certainly be followed by the night.
And when the night passes, the morning shall again dawn. ||2||
In the love of Maya, the unfortunate ones remain in sleep.
By Guru's Grace, a rare few remain awake and aware. ||3||
